# Let me check the exact player position before and after the UP action
# by comparing previous_frame and current_frame
prev_seg = previous_frame.segmentation
curr_seg = current_frame.segmentation

prev_player = None
curr_player = None
for n in prev_seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        prev_player = n['boundary']
        break
for n in curr_seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        curr_player = n['boundary']
        break

print(f"Player after: {curr_player}")

# Check if player moved
if prev_player and curr_player:
    row_before = (prev_player[0][0] + prev_player[2][0]) // 2
    col_before = (prev_player[0][1] + prev_player[2][1]) // 2
    row_after = (curr_player[0][0] + curr_player[2][0]) // 2
    col_after = (curr_player[0][1] + curr_player[2][1]) // 2
    print(f"Player center: ({row_before}, {col_before}) -> ({row_after}, {col_after})")
    print(f"Movement: row {row_after-row_before:+d}, col {col_after-col_before:+d}")

# Player seems blocked from moving UP. Let me try LEFT to move towards the blue boxes
print("\nTrying LEFT")
action(['LEFT'])
</parameter>
</function>
